title: ooRexx package import boundary for HttpResponse
summary: In ooRexx, public classes are imported through package dependency relationships. If the main application requires HTTPS Server and McpHttpsRoute as siblings, HttpResponse exported by the HTTPS package is not automatically visible inside McpHttpsRoute. v0.2-dev1 therefore raised Error 97.1 at .HttpResponse~json on live requests. v0.2-dev5 fixes this by directly requiring https_server.cls from McpHttpsRoute.cls.
invariants: Do not rely on the main application loading a sibling package to make its public classes visible inside MCP route package scope.
Qualification must use the real HttpResponse class, not only a contract fake.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
